camel_example: aliyun ada ListSkills --region cn-hangzhou --Q review --NextToken 'eyJzIjoiZDc3ZGRhYmE3MDMwYWM1NCIsInAiOjJ9.vkKVySx9G26993sTNLZqwGSmgciRsrRm2SgsjOMJoCQ' --PageSize 20 --Scope CUSTOM --PageNumber 1 --CreatorId 'example-user' --MaxResults 20 --Visibility user --version 2026-07-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries Skills visible to the current caller by paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前调用者可见的 Skill
name: ListSkills

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for cursor-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: `20`. If explicitly specified, cursor-based pagination takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 游标分页的每页数量，取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 `20`。显式传入时优先使用游标分页
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token returned by the server for the next page. Do not pass this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, use the value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 服务端返回的下一页令牌。首次查询时不传，后续查询时使用上一次响应中的值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The page number for compatible page-number-based pagination. Pages start from 1. Default value: `1`
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的页码分页参数，从 1 开始，默认值为 `1`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for compatible page-number-based pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: `20`
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的每页数量，取值范围为 1～100，默认值为 `20`
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 按 Skill 创建者 ID 过滤
parameters.name: creator_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match on the Skill name or description
parameters.help_zh: 按 Skill 名称或描述模糊匹配
parameters.name: q

parameters.help_en: Filters Skills by visibility. Common values are `user` and `tenant`
parameters.help_zh: 按可见性过滤。常用值为 `user` 和 `tenant`
parameters.name: visibility

parameters.help_en: The query scope for Skills. Valid values: `SYSTEM` and `CUSTOM`. If omitted, both official and custom Skills are queried
parameters.help_zh: Skill 查询范围。可选值为 `SYSTEM` 和 `CUSTOM`；省略时合并查询官方和自定义 Skill
parameters.name: scope

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries per page for the current cursor-based pagination
MaxResults.description_zh: 当前游标分页的每页数量

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty string is returned if there is no next page
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页令牌。没有下一页时返回空字符串

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number for compatible page-number-based pagination

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for compatible page-number-based pagination
PageSize.description_zh: 当前兼容分页的每页数量

Skills.description_en: The list of Skill summaries. The current public contract does not define a fixed structure for list items. For common fields, see "Supplementary description of response elements"
Skills.description_zh: Skill 摘要列表。当前公共契约未固定列表项结构，常见字段参见“返回参数补充说明”

items.description_en: The Skill summary list item. For common fields, see the supplementary description of response elements
items.description_zh: Skill 摘要列表项，常见字段参见返回参数补充说明

Total.description_en: The total number of Skills that match the current visibility and filter conditions
Total.description_zh: 符合当前可见性和过滤条件的 Skill 总数
